usage: 大雨 is used to describe heavy rain, a noun. It represents a strong or intense rainfall.
You can use 大雨 to talk about the weather condition currently happening or forecasted.
In sentences, 大雨 usually functions as a subject or object, e.g., 大雨落咗 (Heavy rain has fallen).
Linking 大雨 with verbs like '落' (fall) or '停' (stop) helps to describe when the heavy rain happens or stops.
You may also use 大雨 with adjectives or other descriptors to specify how heavy or long it lasts.
